lines.en: label day48:
scene bedroom_day
I wind up waking up without Ami's assistance, which is strange given that today is a[school] day...so I quickly begin going over possible explanations for this in my head.
lines.zh: 我没有靠 Ami 叫就自己醒过来了，考虑到今天是个要上[school]的日子，这很奇怪……于是我赶紧在脑子里过了一遍可能的解释。

lines.en: Explanation 1: She was murdered.
lines.zh: 解释一：她被谋杀了。

lines.en: Explanation 2: Today is some sort of national holiday that I am unaware of.
lines.zh: 解释二：今天是某个我不知道的国定假日。

lines.en: Explanation 3: She was murdered and today is some sort of national holiday that I am unaware of.
lines.zh: 解释三：她被谋杀了，而且今天是某个我不知道的国定假日。

lines.en: I'm really hoping it's not that last one because it sounds like it would make arranging her funeral very difficult.
lines.zh: 我真希望不是最后那个，因为听起来那会让安排她的葬礼变得非常困难。

lines.en: scene black
I walk out into the kitchen and prepare myself for whatever crime scene awaits.
lines.zh: 我走进厨房，为等着我的任何犯罪现场做好心理准备。

lines.en: However, what awaits is no crime scene at all...
lines.zh: 然而，等着我的根本不是什么犯罪现场……

lines.en: scene amicouch1
It's simply the girl who didn't wake me up this morning, half-passed out with a huge blanket I have never seen before pulled over her body.
lines.zh: 只是那个今早没叫醒我的女孩，半昏半睡地躺着，身上盖着一床我从没见过的大毯子。

lines.en: : I think...I might be dying...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我可能要死了……

lines.en: jump littlegirlx
label littlegirlx:
: Well, at least you're not dead already.
lines.zh: : 嗯，至少你还没死。

lines.en: : When is breakfast?
lines.zh: : 早饭什么时候好？

lines.en: : I don't...think I can make breakfast today, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得今天做不了早饭了，老师……

lines.en: : I'm really sorry...
lines.zh: : 真的很抱歉……

lines.en: : Yeah...I was kind of expecting that to be the answer. But that doesn't mean I can't be upset about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我大概猜到会是这个答案。但这不妨碍我为此难过。

lines.en: : I'll make you...two breakfasts tomorrow to make up for it...
lines.zh: : 我明天……给你做两份早饭补上……

lines.en: : Don't even worry about it, Ami. Just...get some rest and...stop being sick.
lines.zh: : 别担心这个了，Ami。就……好好休息，然后……别再生病了。

lines.en: : I don't think you would make a very good doctor...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你当医生肯定不怎么样……

lines.en: : I don't think I would make a very good anything, so that's fair.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我干什么都不会太怎么样，所以这话说得公平。

lines.en: So, as you may have noticed, the reason Ami wasn’t able to wake me up this morning is because she’s suddenly fallen ill.
lines.zh: 那么，正如你可能已经注意到的，Ami 今早没能叫醒我，是因为她突然病倒了。

lines.en: The part I don't get is why she'd decide to be sick out here instead of in her room.
lines.zh: 我不明白的是，她为什么会选择在这里生病，而不是在自己房间里。

lines.en: : This is it, Sensei...I'm really going to die...
lines.zh: : 就是现在了，老师……我真的要死了……

lines.en: : You're not going to die, Ami...
lines.zh: : 你不会死的，Ami……

lines.en: scene amicouch2
: Please don’t...forget me when I’m gone...
lines.zh: : 我走了以后……请别……忘了我……

lines.en: : I'll never forget you. Not until I get my last two breakfasts.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会忘记你。至少在我拿到欠我的那两份早饭之前不会。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...hah...so...funny...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……哈……哈……真……真好笑……

lines.en: : What's wrong, exactly? Is it anything medicine could fix? Or...
lines.zh: : 到底是什么毛病？吃药能解决的吗？还是……

lines.en: : My everything hurts and I have a fever.
lines.zh: : 我浑身都疼，而且还发烧。

lines.en: : You took your temperature already?
lines.zh: : 你已经量过体温了？

lines.en: : Yes...
: And what was it?
lines.zh: : 多少度？

lines.en: : Six million.
lines.zh: : 六百万。

lines.en: : Did you take your temperature on the sun?
lines.zh: : 你是在太阳上量的体温吗？

lines.en: : The real answer is...102...
lines.zh: : 真正的答案是……102……

lines.en: : I think it's probably the flu or something...
lines.zh: : 我觉得大概是流感什么的……

lines.en: scene amicouch1
: It took every bit of strength I had to even pick up the thermometer...
lines.zh: : 光是把体温计拿起来，就花光了我所有的力气……

lines.en: : Sensei...what am I supposed to do? If I can't take care of you, what am I even good for?
lines.zh: : 老师……我该怎么办？如果我连照顾你都做不到，我还能有什么用？

lines.en: : Hey, I'm sure there's plenty of other stuff you're good for. I'm just blissfully unaware of it right now.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我敢肯定你擅长的事还有很多。只是我现在幸福地一无所知罢了。

lines.en: : Plus, it would only be fair if I took care of you sometimes in return, right?
lines.zh: : 再说，偶尔换我来照顾你，才公平吧？

lines.en: scene amicouch3
: I can't ask you to do that...
lines.zh: : 我不能要求你那样做……

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能？

lines.en: : Because that's...not how this goes...
lines.zh: : 因为那……不是我们之间的相处方式……

lines.en: : Well, that's how it goes today. What can I do? What do you need?
lines.zh: : 嗯，今天就按我的方式来。我能做什么？你需要什么？

lines.en: scene amicouch1
: You have to go to[school], Sensei...You can't stay here with me.
lines.zh: : 你得去[school]啊，老师……你不能待在这儿陪我。

lines.en: : I’ll call the school and let them know that neither of us will be coming in today.
lines.zh: : 我会给学校打电话，告诉他们我们两个今天都不去了。

lines.en: : If it really is the flu, I've already been exposed to it by talking to you, so we're both screwed either way.
lines.zh: : 如果真是流感，我跟你说了这么久的话，早就已经被传染了，所以不管怎样我们都完蛋了。

lines.en: scene amicouch4
: Are...you really okay with that?...Staying here with me?...
lines.zh: : 你……真的不介意吗？……陪我待在这儿？……

lines.en: : Of course. The quicker you recover, the quicker I can eat again.
lines.zh: : 当然。你越早好起来，我就能越早吃上饭。

lines.en: : That and I don’t like seeing you acting like you're on the brink of death. It’s depressing.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，我不喜欢看你一副快死的样子。太丧了。

lines.en: : Well...it’s not like I really enjoy feeling this way either...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也不是真的喜欢这种感觉啊……

lines.en: : But you don't have to take care of me, Sensei...What will you do if you actually do get sick and have to miss more than one day of[school]?
lines.zh: : 可你不用照顾我啊，老师……万一你真的病倒了，得请不止一天[school]的假，你怎么办？

lines.en: : You should...abandon me while you have the chance...
lines.zh: : 你应该……趁还有机会赶紧抛弃我……

lines.en: : If that happens I'll just...miss more days, I guess. It's not a big deal.
lines.zh: : 要是真那样，我就……多请几天假呗。没什么大不了的。

lines.en: Now that I think about it, I’m not really sure how time off even works at my job.
lines.zh: 现在想想，我其实不太清楚我这份工作的休假到底是怎么算的。

lines.en: Do I even get time off? How does calling out sick as a teacher work, exactly?
lines.zh: 我到底有没有休假？当老师的请病假，具体是怎么个流程？

lines.en: : Hey, on the bright side...if I actually do get sick, that means you can take care of me next. And that doesn’t sound all that bad, does it?
lines.zh: : 嘿，往好处想……要是我真病了，那下次就轮到你照顾我了。听起来也不赖吧？

lines.en: scene amicouch5
: Unless we’re both sick...Then Maya and Ayane will have to come over and take care of us.
lines.zh: : 除非我们两个都病了……那就得让 Maya 和 Ayane 过来照顾我们了。

lines.en: : I doubt Maya will touch me so she'll probably be with you and Ayane will probably be with me.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑 Maya 不会碰我，所以她大概会去照顾你，Ayane 大概会来照顾我。

lines.en: : I’m...kind of worried about how Ayane would take care of you, to be totally honest...
lines.zh: : 说实话……我有点担心 Ayane 会怎么「照顾」你……

lines.en: : So am I, Ami. So am I...But let’s not worry about that for now.
lines.zh: : 我也是，Ami。我也是……不过现在先别操心那个了。

lines.en: : Instead, how about you tell me what I can do to make things more comfortable for you. Are you hungry?
lines.zh: : 不如你告诉我，我怎么做能让你舒服点。你饿吗？

lines.en: : Hungry, no...Maybe a little thirsty, though...
lines.zh: : 不饿……不过可能有点渴……

lines.en: : Do you think you could get me a glass of water?
lines.zh: : 你能给我倒杯水吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll be right back.
lines.zh: : 当然。我马上回来。

lines.en: scene lr_day
I move to the kitchen and remove a thick plastic cup from one of the cabinets.
lines.zh: 我走到厨房，从其中一个柜子里拿出一个厚实的塑料杯。

lines.en: There's a design on the cup that has become cracked and splintered from a mixture of age and being washed an ungodly amount of times.
lines.zh: 杯身上的图案因为年头太久、又被洗了无数次，已经开裂剥落。

lines.en: It's barely visible anymore...but I'm pretty certain that, at some point, it was a sakura tree.
lines.zh: 现在几乎看不清了……但我很确定，那原本是一棵樱花树。

lines.en: I fill the cup with filtered water from a pitcher in the fridge and grab a sleeve of crackers as well, just in case Ami wants to put anything in her stomach.
lines.zh: 我从冰箱里的水壶倒了些过滤水把杯子装满，又顺手拿了一包饼干，以防 Ami 想往胃里垫点东西。

lines.en: After quickly calling the[school] to let them know we won't be coming in today, I return to the couch and save Ami's life.
lines.zh: 迅速给[school]打完电话、说明我们今天不去之后，我回到沙发前，救了 Ami 一命。

lines.en: scene amicouch2
: Ahhh...this is the worst...I feel so useless.
lines.zh: : 啊啊……糟透了……我觉得自己好没用。

lines.en: : Less complaining, more hydrating. Drink this.
lines.zh: : 少抱怨，多喝水。把这个喝了。

lines.en: scene amicouch5
I place the water and crackers on the table in front of Ami and she slowly but surely begins to sip from the glass.
lines.zh: 我把水和饼干放在 Ami 面前的桌上，她慢慢地、但确实地开始小口喝起来。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei...I promise to get better as quickly as I can, okay?
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，老师……我保证会尽快好起来的，好吗？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about that for now. Just try and get some sleep.
lines.zh: : 现在别操心这个。先试着睡一会儿。

lines.en: : That’s what I’ve been trying to do all morning...as you can see, it’s not exactly working.
lines.zh: : 我一早上都在努力睡啊……你也看到了，根本不管用。

lines.en: : I even tried sleeping out here because my bed was starting to feel uncomfortable from how much I was rolling around.
lines.zh: : 我甚至跑到外面来睡，因为我在床上翻来覆去，连床都开始变得不舒服了。

lines.en: : Well, I can't imagine that couch feels much better.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不觉得那张沙发能好到哪儿去。

lines.en: : It doesn't...but at least trying to go to sleep out here gave me the chance to see you...
lines.zh: : 确实不好……但至少试着在外面睡，让我有机会见到你……

lines.en: : You know I would have gone into your room anyway, right? I was pretty sure you were killed when I wasn't woken up this morning.
lines.zh: : 你知道就算那样，我也会进你房间去的吧？今早没被叫醒的时候，我基本断定你被人杀了。

lines.en: scene amicouch6
: Heheh...sorry about that...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……抱歉啊……

lines.en: : I knew you'd find me either way...but every second counts, Sensei...especially now that I am fading away once and for all...
lines.zh: : 我知道你总会找到我的……但每一秒都很宝贵，老师……尤其现在我正在一去不返地消逝……

lines.en: : If you fade away in the next half hour, I might be able to retract my call out from work.
lines.zh: : 要是你在半小时内消逝，我说不定还能撤回我请的假。

lines.en: : Heheh...in that case...I guess I'll just have to hang on for as long as I can...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……那样的话……看来我只能尽量撑久一点了……

lines.en: : Good call. You just beat out nine other girls in a battle for my time, so it's probably safe to say I have a bit of a soft spot for you and don't want you to die just yet.
lines.zh: : 说得对。你刚刚在一场争夺我时间的战斗中击败了另外九个女孩，所以大概可以肯定，我对你还是有点偏心的，暂时还不想让你死。

lines.en: scene amicouch5
: Heheh...I did beat them all...didn't I?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我真的赢了她们所有人……对吧？

lines.en: : I guess...family comes first for both of us...huh?
lines.zh: : 我想……对我们两个来说，家人都是第一位的……嗯？

lines.en: You know...
lines.zh: 你知道吗……

lines.en: Maybe keeping up this whole ‘family’ facade won’t be as hard as I initially thought.
lines.zh: 也许继续维持这层「家人」的伪装，并没有我一开始想的那么难。

lines.en: I mean...I really do feel like Ami’s guardian. And that's even more true now that I'm finally seeing her at her most vulnerable.
lines.zh: 我是说……我真的觉得自己就是 Ami 的监护人。而在我终于看到她最脆弱的样子之后，这种感觉就更强烈了。

lines.en: There are no impure thoughts at all right now- just the true desire for her to get better so I won't have to look at her like this anymore.
lines.zh: 此刻我脑子里没有任何龌龊的念头——只有真心希望她快点好起来，好让我不用再看着她这副模样。

lines.en: I'm sure the fantasies will float right back in once she's able to do things on her own again...but for now...
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，等她又能自己做事的时候，那些幻想就会立刻飘回来……但此刻……

lines.en: I'm content just being near her.
lines.zh: 我只要待在她身边就满足了。

lines.en: And that's not something I think or say very often.
lines.zh: 而这可不是我经常会想、会说的话。

lines.en: scene amicouch6
: Hey...umm...
: I just thought of...something else that might make me feel a little better...
lines.zh: : 我刚想到……还有一件事也许能让我好受点……

lines.en: : Oh yeah? What now?
lines.zh: : 哦？这回又是什么？

lines.en: : Well, I'll tell you, but...you'll be pretty much asking to get sick if you actually go along with it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可以告诉你，不过……你要是真照做了，基本等于主动求着被传染。

lines.en: : I don't really mind that. Shoot.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎。说吧。

lines.en: scene amicouch5
: Would you...maybe want to lay here with me for a little while?
lines.zh: : 你……愿不愿意在这里陪我躺一会儿？

lines.en: : Are you sure that won't make you even more uncomfortable? You have a fever, don't you?
lines.zh: : 你确定那不会让你更难受吗？你还在发烧吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，但是……

lines.en: : I can't imagine having you so close to me would ever make me more uncomfortable...
lines.zh: : 我无法想象你离我这么近，会让我更难受……

lines.en: : Well, I guess I don't really have a choice then. Move over.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我大概是别无选择了。过去点。

lines.en: scene amicouch7
: You mean...you're actually going to do it?
lines.zh: : 你是说……你真的要做？

lines.en: : Of course. We're going to have to squeeze together since the couch is so small, though.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过沙发太小，我们得挤一挤。

lines.en: : Yeah...of course! I don’t mind at all! Here...get in behind me...
lines.zh: : 好……当然！我一点都不介意！来……从后面进来……

lines.en: : I wanna be the little spoon today...
lines.zh: : 今天我想当小勺子……

lines.en: scene black
Ami slides both herself and the pillow up a few inches and stops right before falling off of the couch.
lines.zh: Ami 把自己和枕头往上挪了几英寸，停在了差点从沙发上掉下去的地方。

lines.en: She's close enough to the edge that I have to step over her very carefully so as to not knock her off the couch entirely and speed up her descent into the underworld.
lines.zh: 她离边缘太近了，我必须非常小心地跨过她，才不会把她整个从沙发上撞下去，加速她坠入冥界。

lines.en: Once I'm in place, I attempt to level my head with hers and drape one of my arms over her body to protect her from falling.
lines.zh: 等我躺好，我试着把头与她的头对齐，并把一只手臂搭在她身上，防止她掉下去。

lines.en: In the act of doing so, though, I may be unintentionally assisting her in...falling in different fashion.
lines.zh: 但在做这个动作的过程中，我可能无意间在帮她……以另一种方式坠落。

lines.en: But at least the hurt that will come with that will be all in her head.
lines.zh: 不过至少随之而来的伤害，全都会发生在她的脑子里。

lines.en: scene amicouch8
: Heheh...I feel kinda like a little girl again...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我感觉自己又像个小孩了……

lines.en: scene amicouch9
: Remember how I used to not be able to fall asleep unless you cuddled me at night?
lines.zh: : 还记得吗，以前你要是不抱着我，我就睡不着。
: 还是说……

lines.en: scene amicouch10
: Or is that gone too?...
lines.zh: : 还是说那段记忆也没了？……

lines.en: It's times like this when I wish I could have inherited the memories of this body along with its skin.
lines.zh: 这种时候，我真希望自己能连同这具身体的皮肤一起，把记忆也继承下来。

lines.en: I don't even care that they'd belong to someone else- I just want to understand and connect the way I'm supposed to be able to.
lines.zh: 我甚至不在乎那些记忆属于别人——我只想能够理解、能够建立起我本该能建立的联结。

lines.en: Call it envy if you like- this desire to absorb the life before me...
lines.zh: 你想把这叫嫉妒也行——这种想要把眼前的人生吸收进去的渴望……

lines.en: But I don't think it's envy at all.
lines.zh: 但我根本不觉得那是嫉妒。

lines.en: I think that if I am going to keep living this life, I deserve everything that is supposed to be packaged with it.
lines.zh: 我觉得，既然我要继续过这一生，我就该得到本该与它配套的一切。

lines.en: There is no point in cracking open a shell with nothing inside of it. And right now, I'm afraid that “Yes, I remember that” will cause a series of cracks to begin splintering across the surface of my conscience.
lines.zh: 敲开一个空无一物的壳没有任何意义。而此刻我害怕的是，「嗯，我记得」这句话会让我的良心表面开始裂开一道道细纹。

lines.en: I'm worried that, before long, the cracks will grow bigger. And that people will realize there was never anything inside of me at all.
lines.zh: 我担心用不了多久，这些裂纹就会越变越大。担心人们终将意识到，我里面从头到尾什么都没有。

lines.en: And yet-
lines.zh: 然而——

lines.en: I'm going to lie anyway.
lines.zh: 我还是要撒谎。

lines.en: I'm going to lie because that is the easiest thing to do right now.
lines.zh: 我要撒谎，因为那是此刻最容易做到的事。

lines.en: And because it's the thing that will hurt this girl the least.
lines.zh: 也因为那是对这个女孩伤害最小的做法。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I remember that, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我记得，Ami。

lines.en: scene amicouch9
: Good...I knew there were some bits and pieces of me left in there.
lines.zh: : 太好了……我就知道里面还留着一点关于我的碎片。

lines.en: : In fact, I'm still not entirely convinced this whole amnesia thing isn't just some really long prank you can't figure out how to end.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我到现在都不太相信这个失忆的破事，不是你自己都收不了场的一个超长恶作剧。

lines.en: : That would require a level of dedication I simply do not have, Ami.
lines.zh: : 那得需要一种我压根不具备的执着，Ami。

lines.en: : Sensei...do you think I’ve changed at all in the last few years?
lines.zh: : 老师……你觉得我这几年来有变化吗？

lines.en: : Changed? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 变化？什么意思？

lines.en: : Like...do I maybe seem more...grown up now?
lines.zh: : 比如……我是不是看起来更……成熟了？

lines.en: scene amicouch10
: Because...I’ve been trying really hard, you know?
lines.zh: : 因为……我一直很努力啊，你知道吗？
